content: Step 2 of the Two-Step Strategy recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) involves performing a 100-gram oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) after an initial screening. Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is diagnosed if two or more of the following plasma glucose thresholds are met or exceeded: Fasting plasma glucose level is greater than or equal to 95 mg/dL (5.3 mmol/L). Plasma glucose level at 1 hour post-glucose load is greater than or equal to 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L). Plasma glucose level at 2 hours post-glucose load is greater than or equal to 155 mg/dL (8.6 mmol/L). Plasma glucose level at 3 hours post-glucose load is greater than or equal to 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L).
